summary: B5 result: forced inlining of contact-model calls and -fno-math-errno give no Pair speed-up on the 25k bed (inlining 1.09x slower, CI excludes 1); time is dominated by load latency (x[j], contact history, sidata), refuting the PF-05 call-overhead hypothesis. Inlining changes last bits via FMA contraction across the former call boundary
evidence_ref: Re-scope: either accept an FMA rebaseline (-ffp-contract policy) and then inline, or target load latency with data-layout work (neighbour/history locality, Atom-level sorting)
